legs.description: Merchandise & Smartphone Recovery receivable restatement (A12): sets the recorded receivable for merchandise_recovery_plans c75a2acc-6dcf-47ba-bce3-2213bfb40ad1 to its operational outstanding balance of 257400.00 (was 0.00). Reason: Agent Products and Services receivables restated to their operational outstanding balances: each agent advance, advance access fee, merchandise and smartphone recovery plan, bike recovery plan, credit access draw and merchandise credit sale now carries its own named receivable account, and recognition with no supporting operational record is de-recognised (2026-09-22 Book of Accounts correction).

Opening-balance counterpart of the Merchandise & Smartphone Recovery receivable restatement for merchandise_recovery_plans c75a2acc-6dcf-47ba-bce3-2213bfb40ad1. Reason: Agent Products and Services receivables restated to their operational outstanding balances: each agent advance, advance access fee, merchandise and smartphone recovery plan, bike recovery plan, credit access draw and merchandise credit sale now carries its own named receivable account, and recognition with no supporting operational record is de-recognised (2026-09-22 Book of Accounts correction).

map.notes: Physical cash received by Financial Ops, recognised as cash in transit
Reclass out of Cash and Bank until the cash is physically banked
Cash in transit released when the deposit is banked
Treasury / Cash at Bank increase when Financial Ops banks the cash
Custody obligation raised when Financial Ops receives physical cash for a wallet/float deposit
Offsets the wallet-scope float debit on a physical cash deposit: the cash is held by the company (A5), not by the agent
Source leg of a float->withdrawable reclass: cash_out credits Float with Agents.
Destination leg of a withdrawable->float reclass: debits Float with Agents.

Partner self-support funding drawn from the partner balance. Reclassifies wallet custody (L1) into partner capital (L2) on the paired platform leg; no asset moves. Explicit row so resolution no longer depends on wallet_bucket, which is an operational funding-source tag.
Wallet-scope counterpart of partner funding and its reversal. Matches all historical partner_funding wallet legs. The platform-scope partner_funding to L2 mapping is unchanged.
Recognition of a promissory note receivable. Posted cash_in so it debits A7. Counterpart credits L2.
Counterpart to partner_receivable_created. Posted cash_out so it credits L2 Partner Portfolios - Capital Held.
Recognition of a Welile Homes subscription receivable. Posted cash_in so it debits A6. Counterpart credits L4.
Counterpart to landlord_receivable_created. Posted cash_out so it credits L4 Landlord Rent Payable.

Settlement of a Welile Homes subscription. Posted cash_in (cash received) which, against debit_when cash_out, credits A6 and reduces the receivable. Replaces rent_repayment on this path, which credits A3 and does not hold this receivable.

Settlement of a promissory note. Posted cash_in (cash received) which, against debit_when cash_out, credits A7 and reduces the receivable. Matches the rent_repayment/agent_repayment convention. Must be used instead of partner_funding, which credits L2 and would double count.
Registration/Access fee economics recognised into Platform Treasury. Post cash_out to CREDIT L7.
Treasury relieved as it is allocated to L3/L5/R1. Post cash_in to DEBIT L7.
Tenant receivable for the fee components of total_repayment. Post cash_in to DEBIT A3.
Partner Reward obligation from Landlord Flow. Post cash_out to CREDIT L3. NOT POSTED until BD-2 resolves.
Agent Commission obligation from Landlord Flow. Post cash_out to CREDIT L5. NOT POSTED until the waterfall is approved.

Platform Net portion of Treasury. Post cash_out to CREDIT R1 (revenue); post cash_in to DEBIT R1 (contra-revenue pricing subsidy). Convention chosen so Treasury groups satisfy both the raw-direction and mapped DR/CR controls.

Bank cash sent out to fund an agent float assignment. Mirrors platform.agent_float_deposit: the platform leg is posted cash_out, which against debit_when cash_in credits A1 and reduces bank cash, while the paired wallet float leg debits A2. Without this row the leg fell to the A9 suspense fallback. [2026-09-15 S2 correction] Float issuance/settlement is an amount due from agents, not bank cash: remapped from A1 to A8 Agent and Merchant Float Cycle Control.
[2026-09-15 S2 correction] Float issuance/settlement is an amount due from agents, not bank cash: remapped from A1 to A8 Agent and Merchant Float Cycle Control.
[2026-09-15 S2 correction] Float issuance/settlement is an amount due from agents, not bank cash: remapped from A1 to A8 Agent and Merchant Float Cycle Control.
[2026-09-15 S2 correction] Float issuance/settlement is an amount due from agents, not bank cash: remapped from A1 to A8 Agent and Merchant Float Cycle Control.
[2026-09-15 S2 correction] Float issuance/settlement is an amount due from agents, not bank cash: remapped from A1 to A8 Agent and Merchant Float Cycle Control.
Destination leg of a float->withdrawable reclass: debits Wallet Custody Payable so the pair nets to zero.
Source leg of a withdrawable->float reclass: cash_out credits Wallet Custody Payable.
Recognition of independently verified banked cash for a verified banking declaration. Debits A1 Cash and Bank.
Counterpart of verified_bank_cash_recognised: float-backed cash banked, so the agent float cycle control account is credited.
Restatement of the Agent Advances receivable to the agent advance's own outstanding balance.
Restatement of the Agent Advance Access Fees receivable to the uncollected access fee.
Restatement of the Merchandise and Smartphone Recovery receivable to the recovery plan's outstanding balance.
Restatement of the Bike Recovery receivable to the recovery plan's outstanding balance.
Restatement of the Credit Access Draws receivable to the draw's outstanding balance.
Restatement of the Merchandise Credit Sales receivable to the sale's outstanding amount.
Recognition path for Service Centre Advances. Nil until an advance exists.
Recognition path for Service Centre Receivables. Nil until a receivable exists.
Recognition of Tenant Service Charge receivables from subscription_charges.accumulated_debt.
Recognition path for Business Advances. Nil until an advance is disbursed.
Restatement of the Rent Access Plans receivable to the plan's own outstanding balance.
Opening-balance counterpart of a receivable restatement. cash_out credits E3 when a receivable is raised; cash_in debits E3 when a receivable is removed.
Accounting-only correction 2026-09-24: float-bucket partner_funding wallet leg is a transfer out of partner custody (Dr L1 on cash_out), not company cash. Previously A2.

Credit side of an agent advance repayment received OUTSIDE the wallet (mobile money, bank transfer, cash). Pairs with a cash_in debit leg to A1 (agent_advance_receipt_bank) or A5 (cash_receipt_in_transit). debit_when = cash_in so the cash_out leg resolves as a CREDIT to A10, which keeps total cash_in = total cash_out inside create_ledger_transaction. Reserved for cfo_record_advance_payment. Added Phase 0 (2026-09-25).

Debit side of an agent advance repayment received by mobile money or bank transfer. DELIBERATELY SEPARATE from verified_bank_cash_recognised, which is reserved for float-backed cash verified as banked, pairs with A8 agent_float_cycle_settled_to_bank and writes bank_cash_recognition_log. Also separate from treasury_bank_deposit and every wallet/deposit category. Pairs with agent_advance_repayment_external (CR A10). Reserved for cfo_record_advance_payment. Added Phase 0 (2026-09-25).
Agent Advance principal advanced. Replaces the rent_disbursement + source_table exception; posted cash_out to debit A10.
Access fee charged at origination or on a top-up/re-term increase. Debits A11.
Flat registration fee charged at origination. Debits A20.
Overdue penalty capitalised into the advance balance. Debits A10; the counterpart is L8, not revenue.
Unearned penalty income. Credited on accrual, debited on collection or write-off. Produces no P&L until collected.
Access-fee share of a repayment. Posted cash_in to credit A11.
Registration-fee share of a repayment. Posted cash_in to credit A20. Distinct from registration_fee_collected, which maps to R1.
Principal and capitalised penalty de-recognised on write-off. Credits A10 against X4; the penalty portion is offset by a DR to L8, so it carries no P&L.
Access-fee receivable de-recognised on write-off or reversal. Credits A11.
Registration-fee receivable de-recognised on write-off or reversal. Credits A20.
Principal de-recognised when an advance is reversed and the clawback has actually settled. Credits A10.
Wallet side of an advance clawback: debits customer custody payable. Amount and bucket are unchanged from the executed movement.
Merchant float return / write-down: mirror of agent_float_deposit platform leg (CR A8). Was unmapped -> A9 suspense until 2026-09-26.

Agent Advance access fee income, recognised in full at origination or top-up. Posted cash_in so it credits R2. CFO decision 2026-09-27: a dedicated account, not R1, so agent lending margin is visible separately from tenant rent-plan fees.

Agent Advance Late Fee income, recognised only on collection by releasing L8. Posted cash_in so it credits R3. CFO decision 2026-09-27: a dedicated account, separate from R2 origination fee income, because Late Fee is default income earned on collection rather than at grant.

Access-fee share of an EXTERNALLY funded repayment (CFO cash/bank receipt). Posted cash_out so it credits A11, mirroring agent_advance_access_fee_collected on the wallet route. Inert until the external receipt branch is revived.
Registration-fee share of an EXTERNALLY funded repayment. Posted cash_out so it credits A20. Inert until the external receipt branch is revived.

Late-fee de-recognition on an EXTERNALLY funded repayment: credits A10 for the capitalised late fee being settled. Posted cash_out. The matching L8 release and R3 income legs need no external variant. Inert until the external receipt branch is revived.
Four-part waterfall Platform Fee (residual). Post cash_in to CREDIT R1.

Four-part waterfall Partner Returns share of collected fees. Accounting allocation HELD in L7 (Platform Treasury holding). NOT revenue, NOT the L3 obligation (BD-2 unresolved), NOT a payment. Supporter Returns remain paid and expensed by the monthly returns engine. Post cash_in to CREDIT L7.
Landlord Float Pool: self-support principal reserved on portfolio approval.
Landlord Float Pool: company-managed principal reserved on portfolio approval.
Landlord Float Pool: free treasury cash leaving A1 into the pool (posted cash_out = CR A1).
Landlord Float Pool: principal part of a tenant repayment returned to the self-support pool.
Landlord Float Pool: principal part of a tenant repayment returned to the company-managed pool.
Landlord Float Pool: collected principal leaving cash in transit into the pool (posted cash_out = CR A5).
Landlord Float Pool: undeployed self-support money released on maturity/redemption (posted cash_out = CR A21).
Landlord Float Pool: undeployed company-managed money released on maturity/redemption (posted cash_out = CR A22).
Landlord Float Pool: released money returning to free treasury cash (DR A1).
Landlord Float Pool: pool money drawn back into treasury to fund a tenant (DR A1); pairs with landlord_pool_deploy_<origin> CR A21/A22. Sits beside the unchanged rent_disbursement group.
Landlord Float Pool: self-support money drawn to fund a tenant (posted cash_out = CR A21); pairs with landlord_pool_deploy_target DR A1.
Landlord Float Pool: company-managed money drawn to fund a tenant (posted cash_out = CR A22); pairs with landlord_pool_deploy_target DR A1.
Landlord Float Pool: a self-support top-up reserved into the pool (pairs with landlord_pool_reserve_source CR A1).
Landlord Float Pool: a company-managed top-up reserved into the pool (pairs with landlord_pool_reserve_source CR A1).
Landlord Float Pool: compounded Returns on a self-support portfolio reserved into the pool (pairs with landlord_pool_reserve_source CR A1).
Landlord Float Pool: compounded Returns on a company-managed portfolio reserved into the pool (pairs with landlord_pool_reserve_source CR A1).
Special Advance paid out to a Welile borrower's withdrawable wallet (owed to them)
Special Advance receivable: principal at payout, plus access and registration fees recognised at payout
Special Advance paid out off-platform to an external borrower (company cash leaves)
Special Advance access / registration fee recognised at payout
Special Advance repayment received into company cash (recorded by the CFO)
Special Advance repayment reduces the receivable
Special Advance impairment: raise (DR X4) or release (CR X4)
Special Advance impairment allowance (contra A24): raise CR, release / use DR
Special Advance written off: the gross receivable leaves A24 (CR)
Special Advance write-off not covered by the allowance (DR X4)
Money recovered on a written-off Special Advance into company cash (DR A1)
Recovery after write-off reduces credit losses (CR X4)
